title: Arkansas Code, Title 26, Subtitle 5, Chapter 51 - Income Taxes
source_id: Ark. Code Ann. tit. 26, ch. 51 (withholding is a subchapter of ch. 51)
verified_how: Expanded 'Title 26 Taxation' then 'Subtitle 5. State Taxes' in the official public-access table of contents: 'Chapter 51 Income Taxes' is listed live between Chapter 50 (General Provisions) and Chapter 52 (Gross Receipts Tax); reserved chapters are marked '[RESERVED.]'.
